Name: Ashur, Father of Tekoa
Summary: Son of Hezron by Abiah, called the father of Tekoa.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:24: Son of Hezron by Abiah, called the father of Tekoa.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Ashur stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
